final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS order_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.order_type, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total AS ratio FROM step1 s1 JOIN step2 s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.order_type, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio AS diff FROM step3 s3 JOIN step4 s4 ON s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio) SELECT SUM(cnt), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM step5
